advisory_notice: All SQA findings, rankings and assessments are recommendations. Master decides whether, when and how to act through docs/plan.json.
priority_assessment: I would let the measurement at 3a7b3877d finish. The longer tests passed in 4 min 59 s and the run reached the model measurements. The comparable MOSS section timings are still due.

I rank SQA-524 first because a retry can report success while omitting the measurement that failed. SQA-525 comes next because every full run repeats file hashing during setup. Both fit the existing measurement runner.

findings.input: A change reaches two selected measurements of a previously measured, untrained model. One succeeds and earns credit. The other fails transiently. The cycle publishes the partial scorecard, which holds a valid reading for that model and task. Interrupt before background fill clears the cycle state, then resume the same commit with unchanged obligations and the transient fault gone.
findings.expected: Keep the successful cell's credit and retry the failed cell before marking the cells phase passed. The measurement runner can keep the original comparison commit for reach selection on resume. Keep the partial publication available while recovery is pending.
findings.actual: Source counterexample at 3a7b3877d. measurePhases records cells=false and publishes at the current commit. On retry, lastRecord selects that partial publication. reachedCells compares the commit with itself and selects nothing. Plan.Chosen drops the failed cell because readBefore accepts any valid reading for its model and task. executeMeasured returns success on an empty selection, so the runner can mark cells passed and republish without retrying the failure. The active run had reached its cells when reviewed. This failure was not observed in that run.

findings.input: Start a recorded full measurement with OVERGO_MEASUREMENT_RUN initially unset in the parent. A runnable cell has an unchanged, readable model file. The dry run and preflight bind it, and background validation binds it again if the cycle reaches fill.
findings.expected: Pass the existing run recorder's environment to the dry run and the background validator. Each unchanged file then needs one successful content hash per started run. Keep the fresh binding on a new run and retry files that could not be hashed.
findings.actual: Source counterexample at 3a7b3877d. measureScorecard starts the dry run with no recorder environment. bindCells hashes the file and keepDigests discards the result. Preflight hashes it again. Background fill passes only cycle credit and hashes it a third time. TestARunHashesEachModelFileOnce sets the environment itself and misses both callers. The active run recorded 311 digest paths totaling 233,832,564,810 bytes by file size. Repeat-read time and physical disk traffic were not measured.

SQA-524.note: Answered by the lead on 2026-11-28 at 3a7b3877d: valid from source, a phase that passes without measuring (a retry reaches its cells from the partial publication at its own commit, so the failed cell is selected by nothing and the cells phase is recorded passed). Not observed. Filed as cells-retry/reach, first: a commit's cells are reached from the newest record of an earlier commit, never its own, so a retry reaches the cells its first attempt did.

SQA-525.note: Answered by the lead on 2026-11-28 at 3a7b3877d: valid from source, a cost every full run pays (the dry run and the fill hash every model file again beside the preflight, 311 paths and 233.8 GB by size at 3a7b3877d). Filed as hash-once/do: both are given the run record's environment, as the phases are.
